name: Salty Scorpid Venom
summary: Salty Scorpid Venom is a caustic fluid harvested from the scorpids stalking the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. Packed with natural salts from the desert floor, it is prized by gnomish rocket racers attempting to engineer volatile, ultra-hot fuel.

sections.title: A Volatile Combustion Agent
sections.body: The scorpids crawling the arid expanse of the Shimmering Flats have adapted to an intensely mineral-rich environment. Over generations, the venom of beasts like the Scorpid Reavers and Scorpid Terrors has absorbed enormous quantities of local salt. Rather than brewing antidotes or standard poisons, gnomish tinkers like Fizzle Brassbolts prize this caustic compound as a prospective additive for high-combustion engine fuel.

sections.title: Fueling the Raceway Rivalry
sections.body: Out at the Mirage Raceway, the engineering competition between gnomes and goblins drives inventors to test increasingly dangerous materials in their rocket cars. Fizzle Brassbolts believes boiling down the salted venom, treating it with specialized catalysts, and mixing it into propellant tanks will deliver the blazing heat necessary to outrun goblin racers on the salt pans.

faq.q: What creatures produce Salty Scorpid Venom?
faq.answer: It is gathered from the dangerous scorpids that roam the salt flats in Thousand Needles, particularly Scorpid Reavers and Scorpid Terrors.

faq.q: Why is the venom so salty?
faq.answer: The scorpids live entirely upon the mineral-crusted ground of the Shimmering Flats. Their physiology absorbs the dense salts of the dried lakebed, infusing their venom glands with a distinct saline concentration.

faq.q: Who wants this venom and why?
faq.answer: Fizzle Brassbolts, a gnome engineer stationed at the Mirage Raceway, seeks the venom to formulate an experimental fuel mixture that burns hot enough to propel his rocket car to victory.

angles.text: Only gnomish ingenuity would consider taking lethal desert venom, combining it with nega-catalysts, and injecting it into a rocket engine just to shave a few seconds off a lap time.
Inventors tinkering in the Shimmering Flats constantly look beyond conventional petroleum and coal, testing organic toxins as volatile combustion accelerants.
